title: Final Starter Effect Verification

verificationNote: All cards used by the 65 authentic starter decks are now assigned to an active exact or verified shared runtime handler. This certifies starter-card runtime coverage; broader non-starter catalogue certification continues separately.

sourceBacklogFromV0943.name: DDT
sourceBacklogFromV0943.text:
Counters head down moves.

Choose one: A random special in your opponent's hand is ditched or you gain +1 Attitude.

sourceBacklogFromV0943.name: Baseball Slide
sourceBacklogFromV0943.text: Play only if your opponent is at ringside while you are in the ring. When you play this move you move to ringside. If it is countered, your opponent ditches two random pages from hand, but you are stunned until the end of the turn.

sourceBacklogFromV0943.name: Hook The Leg
sourceBacklogFromV0943.text:
Play only if you are in control and if your opponent is on the mat in the ring.

You draw a page and attempt a pin. If the pin fails you remain in control and your move string is broken.

sourceBacklogFromV0943.name: DDT
sourceBacklogFromV0943.text:
Counters head down moves.

Choose one: A random special in your opponent's hand is ditched or you gain +1 Attitude.

sourceBacklogFromV0943.name: Taunt
sourceBacklogFromV0943.text:
Draw a page.

Your opponent loses one Attitude. Your next move does +2 damage.

(Heel pages can't be played if you've already played a Face page.)

sourceBacklogFromV0943.name: Boring
sourceBacklogFromV0943.text:
Draw three pages. Use only if your opponent's move and last connected move have the same move type and if you aren't in a submission Hold or in control.
If you ditch this page it counts as two pages.

sourceBacklogFromV0943.name: Break!
sourceBacklogFromV0943.text:
Play if you have hit with two moves in a row, and only if you have not played a move this turn.

Gain 1 Attitude and draw two pages. Your opponent gets control.

sourceBacklogFromV0943.name: Bounce Off The Ropes
sourceBacklogFromV0943.text:
Play only if your opponent is on the mat in the ring. If you have 3 Strike, a random Strike move is drawn from your playbook.
If you play an Impact or Drop move and it connects, that move does +3 damage and you draw a page.

sourceBacklogFromV0943.name: Break!
sourceBacklogFromV0943.text:
Play if you aren't in control and your opponent has 3 or more Attitude than you, and only before turn 30.

Your opponent loses 5 Attitude and ditches a random move from hand.

sourceBacklogFromV0943.name: Always Thinking
sourceBacklogFromV0943.text:
Draw a page.
After you draw a page during the Refresh step, you are told what the next page is. Multiple uses of this page allow you to see more pages from your playbook. If you are stunned, this page leaves play.

sourceBacklogFromV0943.name: Taunt
sourceBacklogFromV0943.text:
Draw a page.

Your opponent loses one Momentum. Your next move does +2 damage. (Heel page: cannot be played if you have played a Face page.)

sourceBacklogFromV0943.name: Bounce Off The Ropes
sourceBacklogFromV0943.text: Play only if your opponent is on the mat in the ring. If you have 3 Strike, a random Strike move is drawn from your playbook. If you play an Impact or Drop move and it connects, that move does +3 damage and you draw a page.

sourceBacklogFromV0943.name: Disadvantage
sourceBacklogFromV0943.text:
Play only while not in control.

Choose one: Your opponent's Damage specials are removed from play, or you draw a page and your opponent's move does -2 damage.

sourceBacklogFromV0943.name: Hook The Leg
sourceBacklogFromV0943.text:
Play only if you are in control and if your opponent is on the mat in the ring.
Draw a page and Pin your opponent. If this pin attempt does not work you remain in Control, and your move string is broken.

sourceBacklogFromV0943.name: Hook The Leg
sourceBacklogFromV0943.text: Play only if you are in control and if your opponent is on the mat in the ring. You attempt to pin your opponent. If you have attempted more pins than your opponent, the attempt gets a +15% pin chance bonus.

sourceBacklogFromV0943.name: Will To Win
sourceBacklogFromV0943.text:
Willpower 3 (This page counts as three for Autocountering.)

This page can't be played.

sourceBacklogFromV0943.name: Half-Brother D-Von
sourceBacklogFromV0943.text:
Bubba Ray Dudley Trademark

Play only if D-Von isn't in the match. When at ringside, your opponent ditches a random momentum or special from hand at the end of each turn. 
Special: When you are in control and your opponent is on the mat, D-Von puts a Table into play. Use once per game.

sourceBacklogFromV0943.name: Half-Brother D-Von
sourceBacklogFromV0943.text:
Bubba Ray Dudley Trademark

Play only if D-Von isn't in the match. When at ringside, your opponent ditches a random momentum or special from hand at the end of each turn. 
Special: When you are in control and your opponent is on the mat, D-Von puts a Table into play. Use once per game.

sourceBacklogFromV0943.name: Half-Brother Bubba Ray
sourceBacklogFromV0943.text:
Dudleyz Trademark

Play only if Bubba Ray isn't in play. Your opponent cannot play Support or Run In pages.

Special: Your opponent is put on the mat and you receive two Warnings. Use only three times per match, and only when in control.

sourceBacklogFromV0943.name: Catch Him Stunned
sourceBacklogFromV0943.text:
Play only if you are in control and your opponent is Stunned.

Your opponent ditches three pages at random and you attempt a pin.

sourceBacklogFromV0943.name: I Got Your Back
sourceBacklogFromV0943.text: Your opponent's Support is removed from play. You draw a random Support special from your playbook.

sourceBacklogFromV0943.name: Going Up Top!
sourceBacklogFromV0943.text: Play if you have hit two moves in a row, and only with a high risk move. Draw a page. If the move connects your opponent ditches a page. If it doesn't connect, you draw another page.

sourceBacklogFromV0943.name: That Was Three!
sourceBacklogFromV0943.text:
Play while being pinned, and can be played while Stunned. The pin fails and you gain control.
(Face page: cannot be played if you have played a Heel page.
Event: can only be played once per match, and only three Events total.)

sourceBacklogFromV0943.name: Building Momentum
sourceBacklogFromV0943.text: Choose a number from 1 to 3. You draw that many random common momentum pages from your playbook (but not more than your Attitude), then lose that much Attitude.

sourceBacklogFromV0943.name: Hardcore
sourceBacklogFromV0943.text:
Hardcore Trademark

For the next 5 turns (including this one) you can't be stunned and both you and your opponent take -2 damage from moves.

sourceBacklogFromV0943.name: Always Thinking
sourceBacklogFromV0943.text:
Draw a page.
After you draw a page during the Refresh step, you are told what the next page is. This effect lasts until you are Stunned. Multiple uses of this page allow you to see more pages from your playbook.

sourceBacklogFromV0943.name: Achilles' Heel
sourceBacklogFromV0943.text: Whenever you apply a Hold, it does +2 to +6 submission damage (randomly chosen each time). This page is removed when you are Stunned. You can only have one Achilles' Heel in play.

sourceBacklogFromV0943.name: Get a Shoulder Up
sourceBacklogFromV0943.text:
Play only if you have 4 Strength or 4 Agility, only while being pinned, and only twice per match. Your opponent's pin attempt fails and you gain Control. 
(Face page: cannot be played if you have played a Heel page.)

sourceBacklogFromV0943.name: High Spot
sourceBacklogFromV0943.text:
Play only if your opponent is on the mat.

Choose a Move page in your playbook that costs 6 or more and draw it.
If your next move this turn is High Risk, you gain 1 Momentum.

sourceBacklogFromV0943.name: Advantage: Impact
sourceBacklogFromV0943.text:
Whenever you connect with an Impact move your opponent loses an extra Attitude.

If you have 4 Strike and 4 Agility, the move does +3 damage and you also gain +1 Attitude.

sourceBacklogFromV0943.name: Big and Nasty
sourceBacklogFromV0943.text:
Big Show Trademark

Your Strength moves do +2 damage. Your Strike moves that cost 4 or more have a 33% chance of stunning your opponent until the end of next turn. This page leaves play if you are hit with 3 moves in a row. You can only have one Big and Nasty in play.

sourceBacklogFromV0943.name: Big and Nasty
sourceBacklogFromV0943.text:
Big Show Trademark

Your Strength moves do +2 damage. Your Strike moves that cost 4 or more have a 33% chance of stunning your opponent. This page leaves play if you are hit with 3 moves in a row. You can only have one Big and Nasty in play.

sourceBacklogFromV0943.name: Everything Hurts
sourceBacklogFromV0943.text: All of your Strike moves do +1 damage for each of your opponent's damaged body parts. You can only have one Everything Hurts in play.

sourceBacklogFromV0943.name: Triple
sourceBacklogFromV0943.text:
Special: Best In The Business

Choose a page in your playbook. It is drawn to your hand. Use this ability once after turn 10 and once after turn 40.

sourceBacklogFromV0943.name: High Knee
sourceBacklogFromV0943.text:
Triple H Trademark

Counters mad rush moves. Your opponent is put on the mat and ditches pages from his playbook equal to your Attitude. This move cant be countered by Strength moves.

sourceBacklogFromV0943.name: Hello!
sourceBacklogFromV0943.text:
William Regal Trademark

Play only if your opponent is on the mat and you have hit two moves in a row.

Name a Special in your deck, which is drawn to your hand.  Gain one Attitude.  (You can't play this if there are no Specials left in your playbook.)
